text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with hematuria and right flank pain; to help me diagnose the underlying cause, please describe exactly where the pain is located, how severe it is on a scale of 1 to 10, and if you have noticed any fever, chills, or nausea.

speaker: Patient
text: 42-year-old Caucasian male. The patient reports experiencing visible blood in his urine accompanied by discomfort in his right flank. He denies any recent trauma to the area. He mentions a series of urinary tract infections over the past few years but has not been on renal dialysis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Renal Cell Carcinoma

I have noted your history of recurrent urinary tract infections and the presence of visible blood in your urine alongside right flank pain. To confirm my suspicion and rule out other causes like a kidney stone or infection, please undergo a CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis with contrast. REQUEST TEST: CT Abdomen Pelvis with Contrast
